# clavis check

<p class="cli-lead">Validate an environment against the project&#39;s secret schema</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis check [flags]
```

</div>

Validate an environment against the project schema. Missing required
keys, wrong types, pattern failures and invalid enum values are errors;
missing optional keys and keys not in the schema are warnings.

## Examples

```sh
clavis check
clavis check --env production
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Every environment</p>

```sh
clavis check --all
```

## Flags

<dl class="cli-flags">
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-all"><dt><code>--all</code></dt><dd>check every environment in the project</dd></div>
</dl>

## Details

Exits with code `6` when a check fails, so `clavis check --env production` can gate a deploy in CI.
